api_contract.time_struct_from_in: struct ds3231_time drv = { .year = in->year - 2000, .month = in->month, .day = in->day, .hour = in->hour, .minute = in->minute, .second = in->second, .weekday = in->weekday };

test_stimuli.name: zero_time
test_stimuli.derivation: BCD bytes: sec=0x00=0, min=0x00=0, hr=0x00=0, day=0x01=1, date=0x01=1, month=0x01=1, year=0x00=0 -> year+2000=2000
